TuberTower

solo / duo

A 150 mm-deep roll-out bed lets bulky rhizomes swell naturally. Graphene heat-loops hold 24–26 °C, and an ultrasonic Rhizo-Shield™ loosens root hairs so tubers lift mud-free.

Crop Categories & Cultivars

Roots & stems – Baby Sweet Potato, Dwarf Taro, Young Lotus Root, Baby Ginger
